err_auth: Wrong username or password. Check the address and the password you pasted.
err_app_password: Wrong app password. Create a new app password (Google needs 2-Step Verification first), paste exactly the 16 characters, and not your normal password.
err_connect: Could not connect to the mail server. Check the server name and the port, and that the server accepts connections from the internet.
err_timeout: The mail server did not answer in time. Check the server name and port, or try again in a minute.
err_dns: That server name does not exist. Check the spelling of the SMTP server.
err_tls: The secure connection failed. Try the other Security option (STARTTLS on 587, SSL/TLS on 465) or check the server name.
err_sender: The server refuses this sender address. Use the mailbox you logged in with, or an address your provider has verified for sending.
err_recipient: The recipient address was refused. Check that it is spelled correctly.
err_limit: The provider's sending limit was reached. Try again later.
err_unknown: The mail server refused the message.
err_no_smtp: Outgoing email is not set up yet: connect an SMTP account in Connections > Outgoing email.
err_gate: A customer email can only be sent after it has passed the authority check.
err_rate: Too many emails were sent in the last hour. Try again later.
err_bad_recipient: The recipient email address is not valid.
err_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
err_fields: Fill in the from name, the from email, the username and the password.
err_host: Enter the SMTP server name, for example smtp.yourprovider.com.
err_port: The port must be a number such as 587 or 465.
err_email: That email address is not valid.
err_not_connected: Send a test email successfully first.
chooseHint: Where does your email live today?
prefilled: Filled in for you: server {host}, port {port}, {security}.
fieldFromNameHint: Customers see this name, for example your shop's name.
fieldFromEmailHint: The address mail is sent from.
fieldReplyToHint: Where replies go, if different from the sender.
passwordStored: The password is stored encrypted and is never shown again.
testToHint: Your own address, so you can check it arrives.
testOk: Sent to {to}. Open that mailbox to confirm it arrived (check Spam too).
testBody:
This is a test email from NIVO for {shop}.

If you can read it, your outgoing email works and NIVO can send reports and receipts for you.
makeDefault: Use as the default outgoing email
makeDefaultHint: NIVO sends all this shop's email from the default connection.
notConnectedYet: The connection becomes active after one test email is sent successfully.
rowPasswordChanged: Password changed. Send a test email to confirm it works.
pipesIntro: Ready-made emails NIVO sends for you. They use your Outgoing email connection and your wording.
pipeStarted: Started. The result appears in the history below.
pipeNotQueued: Could not start (is the engine online?).
